lines.en: I walk at you, never around
One eye stays open the whole time
I come on step by step, perfectly even
There is no hesitation in my feet
My direction is you
I cross the threshold without pausing
The body moves, the eye does not

lines.zh: 我沿着走廊，一点点逼近。
lines.en: I creep down the corridor, bit by bit.
Within five blocks, I stop
I stay quiet this whole way

lines.zh: 我的影子正对着你的门
lines.en: My shadow falls square on your door
I am not fast, but I do not stop
I halt just outside five blocks
My eye is fixed on you
I do not move and I do not blink

lines.zh: 站着比走着更让人难受
lines.en: Standing still is worse than walking
I am waiting for you to edge back

lines.zh: 五格之内，我就停下看你。
lines.en: Within five blocks, I stop and stare.

lines.zh: 我的目光没有重量，却很沉
lines.en: My gaze has no weight, yet it presses

lines.zh: 我悬浮着，眼皮一动不动。
lines.en: I hover, my eyelid utterly still.
That corner is dark, I do not go
I stand, and your movement means nothing
I tilt my head a fraction
Only five blocks remain between us

lines.zh: 我一直在五格的距离上
lines.en: I stay at exactly five blocks
The light in this room is not enough
You see I have only one eye
Do not back away, I take one step for each

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我们就这样
lines.en: Stand still, let us stay like this
Step within five blocks and I stop
You go left, my eye goes left
This eye has followed you a long while

lines.zh: 你的脸在我眼里很清楚
lines.en: Your face is very clear in my eye
I do not speak, I cannot
You look at me, and I look at you
Put your hands down
I have stayed at five blocks all along
I cannot hear your breathing
This stare came on slowly
I can see clearly without coming closer

lines.zh: 你的影子往左，我却看你。
lines.en: Your shadow moves left; I watch you instead.
I stare at you until you leave

lines.zh: 你转开脸，我就不在看你
lines.en: Look away, and I stop watching
I set this distance
I will not move, so do not you

lines.zh: 你不动，我就慢慢凑过去。
lines.en: Hold still and I'll drift closer.
My eye wavered
I put some distance between us
I stare, and do not come closer

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的骨头上
lines.en: That landed on my bones
I make no sound, not even in pain
My eye opens again
This wound puts me back at five blocks

lines.zh: 你站的位置，我已刻进眼里。
lines.en: The spot where you stand is carved into my eye.
My outline faded for a moment

lines.zh: 你打我，我也不移开视线。
lines.en: Strike me, and I still will not look away.
I never eat anything

lines.zh: 五格之内，我就停下看你
lines.en: Within five blocks I stop and stare
My eye watches only you
Do not block my line of sight with things

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，挡住你的脸了
lines.en: What you hold is blocking your face
I take nothing and need nothing

lines.zh: 你放在中间，我不会过去
lines.en: Leave it between us, I will not go

lines.zh: 这点东西换不了我的目光
lines.en: That will not buy my gaze
Raising it will not help
I will not look down at it
You walked into my field of view
I am now within five blocks
That contact halted me
I did not move back, you did
My eye is very close to you
What you touched is bone
I have no teeth, only an eye
This close is not to my liking

lines.zh: 我的眼柄碰到你，缩了回去。
lines.en: My eye stalk touches you and recoils.
I return to just beyond five blocks

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，也只够看一个
lines.en: One eye, and it is enough for one
Between kin, there is only a stare

lines.zh: 两个看着彼此，谁都不动
lines.en: Two watching each other, neither moving

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，我需要观众
lines.en: I need no mate, I need an audience
Another eye is somewhere else
We never walk side by side

lines.zh: 相处的方式就是互相盯着
lines.en: Our way together is mutual staring
Keeping distance is courtesy
My kind are few, and I do not mind
This stare could count as an agreement
I reach out, but my eye does not lower
I found it, I cannot see it

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，弯了就看不到你
lines.en: I do not bend, bending loses you
You pick up what dropped first
I push it aside with my foot
It lies there, and I am looking elsewhere
I kick it to your feet

lines.zh: 捡起来之后，你还是我的目标
lines.en: Pick it up, and you are still my target

lines.zh: 我没有手，这东西落在地上。
lines.en: I have no hands; the thing falls to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的视线一次只能放一处
lines.en: My gaze can only rest on one place
I have just seen you
This gaze settles, and it is you
You are in front of me, good

lines.zh: 我的身体离开墙角，向你滑。
lines.en: My body leaves the corner and slides toward you.
I will stop within five blocks
Wherever you go, my eye follows
You are the easiest thing to find here

lines.zh: 我的目光很沉，你感觉得到
lines.en: My gaze is heavy, you can feel it
No need to look up, I am watching
On this path I watch only you
You just entered my field of view

lines.zh: 你站定的时候，我认出了你
lines.en: When you stopped, I recognized you
Exactly this angle
I do not shout, shouting breaks focus
I have your outline memorized

lines.zh: 从现在开始，我不会转开
lines.en: From now on, I will not look away
A few blocks still to go
I measure the distance in steps
You move, and my eye follows

lines.zh: 五格是我给自己定的线
lines.en: Five blocks is the line I set myself
A little closer and I stop
You retreat, I take one step
I do not go around the furniture
Hiding behind the door is useless

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你的心跳一样慢
lines.en: My steps are as slow as your heartbeat
The longer you look, the heavier it gets
This eye does not tire
I am four blocks away
You have backed to the wall, good
I will stop right here and watch
Your hand is searching for something
You cannot cross these five blocks
I do not chase, I wait

lines.zh: 你已经在我眼前很久了
lines.en: You have been before me a long while

lines.zh: 我们就这样，谁先动谁输
lines.en: Let us stay like this, whoever moves loses
The lamp is out, and I still see you
I touched you, very close
My eye presses close before you

lines.zh: 我的注视压在你后颈上。
lines.en: My gaze presses on the back of your neck.
You pulled back half a step
I reach and hold your shoulder
A hand of bone is cold
I come right up to your face
That touch freezes you
I have no mouth, this is all I have

lines.zh: 你身上的热气我感觉得到
lines.en: I feel the warmth coming off you
After that, I draw back again
Within five blocks, you cannot get away
My hand passed through your shadow
Your eyes shut

lines.zh: 我贴近到五格，只盯着你。
lines.en: I close to five paces and only stare.
Do not make a sound, do not move
I stand there, having watched all along

lines.zh: 这个角落刚好能看到你
lines.en: From this corner I can see you perfectly

lines.zh: 我出现的时候一点声都没有
lines.en: I made no sound appearing
An eye surfaces first

lines.zh: 我从房间里最暗的地方开始
lines.en: I begin from the darkest part of the room
Within five blocks, I will stop
My position is already fixed
I begin moving toward you
One look up and you will see me
I know where you are
The light in the room dimmed
I turn my eye your way
This is not a chance appearance
I am slowly taking shape
This shadow belongs to me

lines.zh: 你房间的角落里多了一样东西
lines.en: Something new is in your corner

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，所以很安静
lines.en: I need no breath, so I am silent

lines.zh: 这一眼，从进门就开始了
lines.en: This gaze began at the doorway

lines.zh: 我在你还没回家时就到了
lines.en: I arrived before you got home
Five blocks, not one step more
Firelight stabs into my eye
My eye shut for an instant as I landed
The water clouds my sight

lines.zh: 爆炸的亮让我眼里一片白
lines.en: The blast leaves my eye white with glare

lines.zh: 飞来的东西打中了我的眼边
lines.en: Something flying struck near my eye

lines.zh: 那股力钻进我唯一的眼
lines.en: That force slipped into my only eye
Hunger makes my vision swim

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我的眼受了伤
lines.en: Lightning is too bright, my eye is hurt

lines.zh: 虚空里没有可以盯的东西
lines.en: Nothing in the void to stare at
